purpose: Gas-phase CH3OH reference for T1.18 adsorption energy (vacuum convention).
note: methanol, closed-shell singlet. Convention note: G(CH3OH) here is the ISOLATED-GAS reference; if the T1.18 formula requires a liquid/solution standard state, a Δμ_solvation correction must be added post-hoc.
workflow_before_submit: This dir is a STATIC (IBRION=-1, NSW=0) box-size sanity check in a 15.0 Å cubic box. DO NOT copy CONTCAR directly from ../CH3OH_vacuum/ — that would carry the 15 Å lattice too. Run scripts/prepare_static_from_relax.py after CH3OH_vacuum finishes; it extracts positions only and rewrites POSCAR here with the correct 15.0 Å cell + relaxed coordinates centered. Then submit. Target: |E(20 Å) − E(15 Å)| < 5 meV.
paired_with: CH3OH_vacuum_15A_static and CH3OH_vacuum_20A_static — same relaxed coordinates, different cell.
